items.prompt: A resource wrapper cleans up during an exception. Why is that not enough to claim an order or database change was safely rolled back?
items.modelAnswer: Destructor cleanup releases owned resources under specific lifetime paths. External effects need their own authenticated protocol, transaction/commit/compensation evidence and recovery tests; arbitrary termination may bypass ordinary scope unwinding. A local cleanup trace is not a durable business-outcome guarantee.

criteria.text: Separates local resource cleanup from external transaction results.
Keeps termination and observer-lifetime limits explicit.
